PLANNED.definition: Engineering protocols, sensor architectures, and safety specifications drafted; site requirements formalized.

INSTALLATION_READY.definition: Facility leased; structural rigging mounted; sensors, PTP grandmaster, network, and storage physically staged.

COMMISSIONING.definition: Active on-site hardware burn-in, optical extrinsics survey, PTP lock, CAN decoding, and secondary target tests underway.

INSTRUMENTATION_DESIGN_COMPLETE.definition: All engineering specifications, schemas, synchronization budgets, and safety taxonomies audited and mathematically reconciled.

INSTRUMENTATION_READY_FOR_CAPTURE.definition: All physical Pre-Capture Commissioning Gates (C1 through C6) verified and signed PASS on physical hardware.

PHYSICAL_CAPTURE_AUTHORIZED.definition: Operational authorization granted by Safety Marshal and Facility Management following site inspection, E-Stop testing, and permit signoff. (SEPARATE FROM INSTRUMENTATION READINESS).
PHYSICAL_CAPTURE_AUTHORIZED.authorizing_authority: Safety Marshal + Facility Director (NOT GRANTED BY V3.4-M)

CAPTURE_IN_PROGRESS.definition: Active multi-modal data acquisition during a controlled trial run (L01-L09) or naturalistic operational shift under live safety monitoring.

CAPTURE_ABORTED.definition: Active trial terminated due to a Safety Abort or Data Invalidation Abort condition.

ABORTED_RUN_ARCHIVED.definition: Aborted trial package quarantined in aborted_runs/ with diagnostic telemetry; permanently marked NON_EVIDENTIARY; cannot advance to review or GT.

CAPTURE_COMPLETED.definition: Physical trial run or naturalistic recording concluded nominally without triggering any safety or data abort conditions.
CAPTURE_COMPLETED.next_step: Execution of Post-Capture Data Quality Gates D1 through D6

DATASET_READY_FOR_REVIEW.definition: Post-capture gates D1 through D6 verified PASS; sanitized review packages compiled with zero algorithmic scores or model outputs.

VALIDATION_READY.definition: Double-blind human panel adjudication complete; inter-rater agreement verified; Ground Truth committed with cryptographic signoff.

transitions.condition: Hardware fault or mechanical remount required
Site safety permits, E-Stop verification, Safety Marshal signoff
Run armed by Safety Marshal & Data Operations Lead
Safety Abort or Data Invalidation Abort triggered
Root cause logged; fault cleared; C1-C6 re-verified
Run completes nominally with zero abort conditions tripped
Blinded human panel adjudication consensus committed

strictly_forbidden_transitions.rule: CRITICAL_VIOLATION: Design completeness does not authorize physical capture. Requires physical hardware deployment, commissioning, and Safety Marshal approval.
CRITICAL_VIOLATION: Cannot leapfrog physical capture, data quality verification, and blinded human Ground Truth adjudication.
CRITICAL_VIOLATION: Calibration and bench test artifacts cannot be reviewed as operational dataset.
CRITICAL_VIOLATION: Raw unadjudicated captures cannot establish validation without sanitized human GT review.
CRITICAL_VIOLATION: Aborted runs are strictly non-evidentiary and cannot be reviewed as valid experimental data.
